Strength is graded: a later separator of a 3+ item list fires while a plain two-part coordination stays near zero ('red and white', 'John and Mary'), a repeated preposition or repeated attribute fires harder than the first, and a compositional 'X of Y' ('the destruction of the army') fires while a lexicalised one ('the head/end/Department of the army') does not.
